name: attraction-conversion-sales
description: Week 6 — Mike's prospect-to-partner method, in your words. One sitting builds your enrollment call script, your presentation and your objection playbook; Stacy, the Sales Trainer, plays the agent and scores you — in chat, and by voice in your Cowork project; call prep before every partner call, the debrief after, and follow-up with a real reason; one Morning Call Prep runs for you, drafts only. Reads your Agent Attraction Brain; requires the Brain plugin. Say 'Launch Stacy, my sales trainer' to train; by voice, with her card in your project's Context.
